# Subway Seat for Fresh

Fresh reads themes from ~/.config/fresh/themes/. A theme names a file, not an id, so the .json extension is part of the value.

[Fresh](https://getfresh.dev) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/fresh/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only fresh
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

| London Deep Level | [`london-deep-level.json`](london-deep-level.json) | `~/.config/fresh/themes/london-deep-level.json` |
| London Portland | [`london-portland.json`](london-portland.json) | `~/.config/fresh/themes/london-portland.json` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/fresh/config.json:

```json
{
  "theme": "subway-seat.json"
}
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/fresh/config.json:

```json
{
  "theme": "subway-seat-tunnel.json"
}
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/fresh/config.json:

{

}

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/fresh/config.json:

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/subway-seat.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/subway-seat-enamel.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/london-moquette.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/london-deep-level.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/london-portland.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/paris-guimard.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/paris-catacombes.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/fresh/themes/paris-carrelage.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
